part-time parish support officer - formerly called "parish secretary". this post will complete our downpatrick parish support team which currently comprises james tumelty as assistant parish support officer and fiona connolly as parish finance officer. it is a 16 hour/week, monday to thursday post. the link to the job specification and application is below. please don't be putoff by the detail in that. at its core, what we are seeking is a person with a heart for the parish who has a warm presence on the phone, a strong instinct and respect for confidentiality, the capacity to listen with compassion, the ability to keep us organised so that we are better able to serve the people of the parish. the parish support officer is the welcoming face of downpatrick parish and the link person between our groups, our schools, our families, our priests so that all we do together he lps to build the kingdom of god amongst us. it's not just a job, it's a vocation to serve with a smile. neither fr jim nor i will sit on the interview panel; that part will be in the care of the diocesan team. the time-line for applications is tight. please consider this prayerfully and, if the challenge appeals to apply! we are convinced that the right person is out there waiting to eugene & fr jim full details of the role, including the role profile and employme nt application form, are available on
